title: Create a Greentic Component
summary: Use the current wizard schema and answers flow to create, build, and validate a Greentic component.

modules.title: Capture the Current Wizard Schema
modules.objective: Start from the live component schema instead of remembered command shapes.

steps.instruction: Ask the component wizard for its schema and inspect required fields before creating files.
steps.expected_output: A JSON schema file describing the current component answers contract.

modules.title: Create and Apply Answers
modules.objective: Use an answers file so the operation is reviewable and reproducible.

steps.instruction: Create an answers.json file matching the captured schema.
steps.expected_output: An answers.json file exists and contains the requested component name, package, and bindings.

steps.instruction: Apply the answers through the wizard flow.
steps.expected_output: The component source, manifest, and WIT bindings are created.

modules.title: Run Component QA
modules.objective: Verify the generated component with the current QA and wasm component build flow.

steps.instruction: Run component QA before packaging or wiring the component into a pack.
steps.expected_output: Component QA reports no contract or binding failures.
A wasm32-wasip2 component artifact is produced.

deprecated_commands.reason: The component creation flow is now schema and answers driven.
Old shorthand commands do not capture the current wizard contract.
